# Layout of a filed note

## Section order

1. Date and attendees.
2. Decisions, one per line, each with its owner.
3. Open questions.
4. The raw transcript, last.

## Naming

`YYYY-MM-DD topic.md`, lowercase topic, spaces kept. A note whose name collides with
an existing one gets a `-2` suffix: for example, a second pricing meeting on the same
day is filed as `2026-03-04 pricing review-2.md`.
